Name: Warehouse Line Losses
Trigger: BDC credit losses hit bank warehouse collateral
Current_Position: $299.3B outstanding. JPM marked down software collateral Mar 11.

Key_Insight: Banks hold senior secured but Tricolor = precedent for losses at senior level. JPM first major bank to act.

Name: Revolving Facility Draws
Trigger: BDC stress triggers defensive facility draws
Current_Position: ARCC $5.1B (39 lenders), FSK $4.7B, OBDC $4B, GSBD $2B, PSEC $1.5B
Pathway: BDC Stress → Defensive draws on revolving facilities → Bank syndicate liquidity strain
Key_Insight: Single ARCC failure = 39 banks impaired simultaneously. Syndicate contagion is the systemic risk.

Name: Redemption Gate Cascade
Trigger: LP redemptions exceed fund liquidity buffers
Current_Position: 4 gates confirmed: OBDC II, HLEND, Cliffwater 14%, MS North Haven
Pathway: LP Redemptions → Fund can't meet → Gates/caps → Fear contagion → More redemptions at other funds
Key_Insight: Gates delay but don't prevent. Uncertainty premium spreads to ungated funds. 4 gates in 6 days = cascade LIVE.

Name: Software Markdown Synchronization
Trigger: Multiple funds mark down same software names
Current_Position: 43% of software loans on PIK. JPM marked down software collateral Mar 11.
Pathway: Tech Portfolio Cos marked down → BDC NAV falls → Bank tech loan losses compound (double hit: CRE + lending)
Key_Insight: WAL, TOWN see double hit. Vista/Thoma Bravo named as epicenter (NYT Mar 12). Cross-holder marks converging.

Name: Fund Finance Sub-Line Stress
Trigger: LP capital call failures impair sub-line collateral
Pathway: LP Can't Meet Capital Call → Sub-line collateral impaired → Regional bank exposure (CFG, Huntington, First Citizens)
Key_Insight: Slower channel — requires LP liquidity crisis, not just BDC stress. Oil shock / equity drawdown could trigger.

Name: NAV Facility LTV Breach
Trigger: Portfolio deterioration pushes NAV facility LTV above covenant
Current_Position: $100B current → $600B projected by 2030. Niche lenders (Customers Bank, Piermont) most exposed.
Pathway: Portfolio NAV Declines → LTV Breach → Margin calls on NAV lending facilities → Forced asset sales at distressed marks
Key_Insight: Niche bank exposure means concentrated impact. Small banks can't absorb.

Name: CLO Forced Selling
Trigger: BDC portfolio stress triggers senior tranche mark declines
Pathway: BDC Portfolio Stress → CLO senior tranche marks decline → Banks with CLO holdings take MTM pain → Forced selling
Key_Insight: Indirect but correlated to credit cycle. Bank CLO holdings are the transmission.

Name: Timing Lag (BDC → Bank P&L)
Trigger: BDC portfolio stress appears in current quarter
Current_Position: 2-3 quarter lag. BDC Q4 2025 stress → Bank Q2-Q3 2026 P&L.
Pathway: BDC Credit Events → 2-3 Quarter Lag → Bank earnings impacted → KRE repricing
Key_Insight: Predictable timing. Current BDC stress (Q1 2026) hits bank P&L in Q3-Q4 2026. April bank earnings = Q4 exposure.

Name: Employment → Portfolio Co Debt Service
Trigger: Employment decline >5% in middle market sectors
Pathway: Employment Decline → Middle market revenue -10-15% → Debt service breaks even with PIK → Default acceleration
Key_Insight: Middle market cos highly employment-sensitive. NFP negative = this channel building. LABOR owns the trigger.

Name: Rate Paradox (Cuts → Redemptions)
Current_Position: Not yet triggered — Fed trapped by inflation.
Pathway: Fed Cuts Rates → BDC yields fall → Yield-seeking LPs redeem → Redemption pressure → Gates → Forced sales
Key_Insight: PIK ratio rises mathematically as cash income falls (denominator effect). Rate cuts = perversely BAD for BDC liquidity.

Name: AI Capex Pullback → Neocloud Default
Current_Position: $600B projected 2026 capex. No pullback yet — BRK-14 tracking.
Pathway: Big Tech Capex Cut → Neocloud revenue miss → Debt service fails on $26.6B neocloud debt → BDC NAV hit
Key_Insight: Mirrors 2001 telecom bust (60% decline). CoreWeave, Lambda, Crusoe exposed. GPU collateral depreciates 40-60% in 18mo.

Name: Vendor Finance Circular Risk
Trigger: Neocloud customer defaults on Nvidia financing
Pathway: Nvidia finances customers → Customer defaults → Nvidia writedown → GPU collateral value collapses → BDC NAV impaired
Key_Insight: Circular: NVDA exposed if customers fail. 2000 Lucent analog but 7x larger.

Name: Bank-PC Joint Venture Residual
Pathway: Bank-PC JVs → "Originate-to-share" retains residual exposure → Portfolio stress hits originating bank
Key_Insight: Banks thought they distributed risk. Residual tail risk remains on balance sheet.
